container.note: a ready C++ box that stores many values: vector, set, map…

stack.ar: مكدّس (آخر ما يدخل أوّل ما يخرج)
stack.note: you add and remove only at the top

queue.ar: طابور (أوّل ما يدخل أوّل ما يخرج)
queue.note: you add at the back and remove from the front

key.note: the thing you search by in a map, like a name in a phone book

duplicate.note: a value that appears more than once

comparator.note: a function that says which of two elements comes first

range.note: all positions from l to r

running-sum.note: the sum of everything up to now

difference-array.note: stores only where a change starts and where it ends

pointer.note: here: just an index that walks along the array

sliding-window.note: a subarray [l, r] that moves to the right step by step

merge.note: join two things into one: two groups, or two sorted lists

gcd.note: the biggest number that divides both a and b

lcm.note: the smallest positive number divisible by both a and b

sieve.note: a fast way to find all primes up to n by crossing out multiples

factorisation.note: writing n as a product of primes: 60 = 2·2·3·5

square-root.note: sqrt(n): the number r with r·r = n

power.note: a^b = a multiplied by itself b times

modular-inverse.note: the number that replaces division when you work modulo m

binary.note: numbers written with only the digits 0 and 1

xor.note: 1 when the two bits are different, 0 when they are equal

mask.note: a number whose bits say which items are chosen

subset.note: some of the items (maybe none, maybe all)

precedence.note: which operator the compiler does first

constructive.note: you must build and print one valid answer

invariant.ar: خاصّية ثابتة (لا تتغيّر بعد أي عملية)
invariant.note: something that stays the same after every operation

valid.note: it follows every rule of the statement

alternating.ar: متناوب (واحد من هذا ثم واحد من ذاك)
alternating.note: two kinds that take turns: small, big, small, big…

shift.note: move every element one position, the last one goes to the start

iterator.note: the place of a value inside a container; * opens it

lambda.note: a small function written inside another call, like sort(..., [](int x, int y) { ... })

truth-table.note: a small table: the result of an operator for every pair of input bits
